assets.generationPrompt: Create one original premium square game icon for the open-source browser quiz game Razzia. Square 1:1 composition: a bold orange quiz buzzer and a small fan of abstract blank answer cards, with a magenta lightning-bolt energy accent and a few gold confetti shapes on a deep charcoal background, energetic competitive party-game feel, polished dimensional illustration, high contrast and readable at small size, centered with generous safe padding for circular and rounded-square crops. CRITICAL: all cards must be blank and include no typography. Absolutely no words, letters, numbers, punctuation, titles, logos, watermarks, borders, UI screenshots, brands, trademarks, or copied artwork. Suitable for final 1024x1024 PNG.
